title: Missing Element in Sorted Array
description: Given an integer array `nums` which is sorted in **ascending order** and all of its elements are **unique** and given also an integer `k`, return the `k^th` missing number starting from the leftmost number of the array.

examples.explanation: The missing numbers are [5,6,8,...], hence the third missing number is 8.
The missing numbers are [3,5,6,7,...], hence the third missing number is 6.

constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order, and all the elements are unique.
